title: 1993 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement:
If each of the three operation signs, \(+,\) \(-,\) \(\times,\) is used exactly once in one of the blanks in the expression

\[5 \, \underline{\phantom{x}} \, 4 \, \underline{\phantom{x}} \, 6 \, \underline{\phantom{x}} \, 3\]

then the value of the result could equal

solutions.text:
The six arrangements give \(5 \times 4 + 6 - 3 = 23,\) \(5 \times 4 - 6 + 3 = 17,\) \(5 + 4 \times 6 - 3 = 26,\) \(5 - 4 \times 6 + 3 = -16,\) \(5 + 4 - 6 \times 3 = -9,\) and \(5 - 4 + 6 \times 3 = 19.\)

The only value among the choices is \(19.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E .
hints: Multiplication happens before addition and subtraction, so where you place \(\times\) matters most
Work through each way of assigning \(+,\) \(-,\) \(\times\) to the three blanks and compute the result
